chars.SISTER: SISTER: a young woman wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, light blue jeans, white sneakers and a small brown backpack.
chars.COUSIN: COUSIN: a young woman wearing a shiny black leather jacket over a bright red top, tight black trousers, big gold hoop earrings and red high heels.
chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan mother in her fifties wearing a beige djellaba and a white headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the end of a narrow Moroccan apartment hallway, as if the viewer is the younger brother standing there: SISTER is opening the front door to leave, a travel bag on her shoulder, glancing back over her shoulder with a secretive guilty look, face clearly visible, head-to-waist framing. Evening light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: SISTER walking alone with her travel bag through a busy Moroccan bus station at dusk (CTM buses in the background, no readable text), determined face, looking at her phone, nobody with her.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: SISTER working behind the counter of a small Moroccan neighbourhood bakery in summer, wearing a white apron over her hoodie, handing bread to a customer's hand at the edge of the frame, trays of msemen and baguettes behind her, she counts a few coins with a satisfied face.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: COUSIN alone unlocking the door of a small rented apartment in Kenitra, holding a key and a cardboard box, smirking proudly, a modern stairwell landing, it is night.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night in a modest Moroccan living room with low sofas: SISTER stands by the door with her backpack, waving goodbye with a forced innocent smile, while MOM sits on the sofa and trusts her, nodding. SISTER's hand behind her back has crossed fingers (she is lying).
